Privacy

Personal information submitted to the Ministry via this site is confidential by law, including the protection of privacy act, 1981.

In order to maintain effective maintenance and efficient management of the site, statistic information is collected by designated software, in a process involving passing information on to an external party's server. This is in order to identify user trends and needs, identify site structure defects, and analyze the system performance level. This information is aggregated with the help of "Cookies", and partial use of the site's "Hits" function.

1. "Cookies" are small files which are received from the web server and written to the web browser. They are usually used to provide a continuity in contact between the user and the server, and are used to collect data.

2. The "cookies" system can be controlled from the browser. Users can cancel the use of "cookies" at any time, and control the flow of information from "cookies". The use of "cookies" is not a condition of use of the site.

3. The statistical data collected when using the site is not used to find the users identity, or for any other use that may harm the users right to privacy, and is used only for the stated uses.

Using "Cookie" files

This site uses Google analytics, a Google product which helps site owners understand user involvement on their site. When visiting this site, your browser automatically sends various data to Google. Google analytics uses "cookie" files found on the computer, in order to help the site analyze how users use the site. The information collected via "cookie" files are sent and stored on Google servers. Google uses this information to assess your use of the site, edit reports on the site activity and use of the internet for the site managers. Google may also pass on data to third parties, when required by law, or when third parties are involved in processing the data for Google. Google will not attribute the IP address with other data from the site. Users can cancel the use of "cookies" at any time, from their browse, however, this may result in some of the site information becoming unavailable.
